utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that repair drive is still happening? I heard they’re looking for volunteers this afternoon, and I can point you to the signup table.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, it's still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s still on. I can walk you over to the signup table after this.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks. I'll send it over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look after lunch. Just tell me what’s broken.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can tell you what’s broken after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works. Just text me when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few more hands for pickup and a couple of tools dropped off. I’m keeping a list if you want to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with pickup. Put me down for one run and I can bring a tool if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after I check the school schedule. What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Late afternoon works for me, maybe around 4? I can keep it flexible if the schedule shifts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4 works for me. I’ll check the school schedule and let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Oren. Let’s keep it simple: tell me the plan, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning. I’ll keep it simple: I’ll bring the tools, check the loose wiring, and if anything looks beyond me I’ll say so right away.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Keep me posted if you find anything that looks off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Pia — I’ve been telling people about the repair drive, and I can put you on the list too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn. Just let me know when and where I should bring things so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll let you know by this afternoon, and I’ll send the exact time and address so you can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m still catching up. What’s the latest on where they need help?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: They still need hands at the houses on Maple and 3rd, mostly for patching and hauling supplies. I can walk you through who’s taking which spot if you want.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me what needs fixing on the repair drive first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The first thing to tackle is anything that affects safety or stops the most people from using their repairs, like broken wiring, leaks, or a door that won't close.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it - I'll start with the safety issues and the repairs that block the most people.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the drive, but I need to keep my hands free today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the heavier part later, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help. I can pass the lighter pieces and keep out of the way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to lend a hand, Mina. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly the leaky porch steps and the loose fence latch. I can bring a hammer, screws, and a wrench.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can map it out if you tell me where the repair drive starts and what time it’s supposed to be.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ve got the start at Maple and 6:30. I’ll send the rest if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it. I’ll wait for the rest and keep the map tight to Maple at 6:30.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with that. Tell me what still needs fixing, and I’ll see what tools I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can walk you through what's left.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, walk me through it and I’ll grab whatever tools make sense.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we should make sure the schedule and pickup details are nailed down first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s handling the pickup and what time it’s scheduled for?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the pickup details too, so let’s confirm the person and exact time before we move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help coordinate a few folks for that repair drive if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules. That would help a lot, and I can fill you in on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring a few spare screws and the hand drill, but I’ll need to check the rest of the supplies list first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can grab the tape measure and a couple more screws if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring what I can and check the rest of the list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re still looking for a few more hands for the repair drive. If you’ve got any free time, I’d say swing by and see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do that, though I may only have a short window between school pickups. If I can make it, I’ll stop by and help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d still be a big help. Even an hour makes a difference, so just come by when you can and we’ll find something quick for you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What do I need to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Bo. I’ve got the list ready, and I’ll send you the repair drive details so you can pick what works best.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, send it over and I’ll pick what I can handle.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. I’ll bring the drive by later today.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll be ready when you bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling everyone about it now, Nell. Come by the repair drive and bring a friend if you can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll swing by and see if I can bring someone along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll keep an eye out for them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the route in mind, but I need the repair drive location again before I can point you to it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s the one off the east side of Miller Lane, past the corner store.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right, east side of Miller Lane past the corner store. I can get there from here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I should check the list first, but I think there’s still a bit left to do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much is still left on the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up again. If you need hands, I can ask around while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, that’d be a big help. I can never keep track of who I already asked.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an eye on who’s already been asked and check back with you if I hear anyone else who can help.
